methodology: Every record states what the source establishes and what it does not establish. Exact rankings are not invented where public disclosure is incomplete.

categories.title: Top 100 Public Companies
categories.description: Rank public companies while separating market value from revenue, assets, cash, voting control and operational control.

categories.title: Top 100 Investment Vehicles
categories.description: Largest identifiable public investment vehicles. Private brokerage accounts are not visible and are never implied.

categories.title: Top 100 Asset Managers
categories.description: Managers allocate client capital; assets under management are not assets owned by the manager.

categories.title: Top 100 Sovereign Wealth Funds
categories.description: State-owned investment pools, their mandates, governance, disclosed holdings and transparency limits.

categories.title: Top 100 Pension Funds
categories.description: Retirement asset owners mapped through beneficiaries, funding, governance, external managers and disclosed allocations.

categories.title: Top 100 Family Offices
categories.description: Only family offices supported by public filings, company disclosures or reliable institutional records.

categories.title: Top 100 Foundations & Endowments
categories.description: Grant, trustee, investment-manager and recipient flows without treating funding as proof of control.

categories.title: Top 100 Publicly Disclosed Trust Structures
categories.description: Only trusts visible in filings, court records, ownership disclosures or official charitable registers.

categories.title: Top 100 Banks & Financial Institutions
categories.description: Systemic banks mapped through assets, deposits, custody, derivatives, state support and regulatory records.

categories.title: Top 100 Private Equity Firms
categories.description: Private-market managers mapped through funds, portfolio companies, pension exposure, fees, debt and exits.

categories.title: Top 100 Hedge Funds
categories.description: Publicly identifiable funds and advisers, with 13F holdings separated from undisclosed positions and leverage.

categories.title: Top 100 Government Contractors
categories.description: Public procurement relationships, awards, agencies, periods and evidence boundaries.

categories.title: Top 100 Property & Land Owners
categories.description: Commercial, residential, logistics, agricultural, timber, data-centre and infrastructure property owners.

categories.title: Top 100 Media Owners
categories.description: Ownership, voting control, platforms, distribution and board relationships across major media groups.

categories.title: Top 100 Technology-Control Companies
categories.description: Cloud, chips, identity, payments, platforms, cyber, data and communications infrastructure.

categories.title: Top 100 Energy & Resource Companies
categories.description: Energy, mining, utilities, grids and strategic resource control with dated measurement boundaries.

categories.title: Top 100 Defence & Security Companies
categories.description: Defence, intelligence-adjacent, cyber and security suppliers mapped through contracts and public filings.

categories.title: Top 100 Political Money Networks
categories.description: Donors, committees, lobbying and policy-funding routes. A payment does not by itself prove corruption or control.

categories.title: Top 100 Philanthropic Power Networks
categories.description: Foundations, donor vehicles, programmes and recipients with grant-flow boundaries.

categories.title: Top 100 Institutional Asset Owners
categories.description: Sovereign funds, pensions, endowments and other asset owners that ultimately mandate investment capital.
